race.description: Dwyer Legal Warrnambool & Port Fairy (Bm62) Hcp
race.comment: GOVERNOR KING (3) can mix his form a bit having struggled badly when in the market at Seymour last time out, that following a dominant win over the same route prior. This won't take any more winning, if things fall his way from the inside gate he's certainly good enough. SHAMEX (7) was a good winner two back at Casterton, good again last time as favourite at Murtoa when sticking on for third. She'll take plenty of catching. ASTRADEEL (1) has a big weight but is up to these on his best and warrants respect. SIR ROCKFORD (6) got home well in town at a big price last start and that reads well, respecting.
